mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscriptions (id, user_id, product, status, started_at, expires_at, auto_renew, store_txn, active_user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{product}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{autoRenew}, #{storeTxn}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE subscriptions SET status = 'CANCELLED', auto_renew = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_entitlements (user_id, kind, source, started_at, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{source}, #{now}, DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL #{days} DAY), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source = VALUES(source), expires_at = DATE_ADD( CASE WHEN expires_at > #{now} THEN expires_at ELSE #{now} END, INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_entitlements WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expires_at > #{now}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_entitlements WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND kind = #{kind} AND expires_at > #{now})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boost_inventory (user_id, kind, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kind}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity)
mapper.update: UPDATE boost_inventory SET quantity = quantity - 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND kind = #{kind} AND quantity > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boost_activations (id, user_id, kind, session_date, started_at, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{kind}, #{sessionDate}, #{startedAt}, #{expiresAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM boost_activations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expires_at > #{now}
SELECT user_id FROM user_entitlements WHERE kind = #{kind} AND expires_at > #{now}
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM boost_activations WHERE expires_at > #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_purchases (id, user_id, platform, product_id, purchase_token, token_hash, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{platform}, #{productId}, #{purchaseToken}, #{tokenHash}, 'GRANTED', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_purchases WHERE platform = #{platform} AND token_hash = #{tokenHash})
